name: Clifton Park Center
summary: Clifton Park Center is an outdoor lifestyle shopping destination in New York's Capital Region, featuring major retailers like Boscov's and JCPenney alongside diverse dining and entertainment options including Regal Cinema and Sky Zone. The center combines traditional shopping with family-friendly amenities and community services, creating a comprehensive destination for residents and visitors alike.
demographics: Clifton Park Center serves a predominantly middle to upper-middle class suburban demographic in the Capital Region of New York, attracting families and professionals from Saratoga County and surrounding areas. The primary trade area consists of households with above-average incomes, with a strong presence of young families seeking family-friendly entertainment and shopping options. Visitors typically range from young adults to middle-aged parents, drawn to the center's mix of value-oriented retailers, family dining, and entertainment venues like Regal Cinema and Sky Zone trampoline park.
description: Clifton Park Center is a vibrant outdoor shopping destination located in Clifton Park, New York, offering a diverse blend of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences for the entire family. The center features a compelling mix of national retailers including department store anchors Boscov's and JCPenney, alongside popular brands like Bath & Body Works, Marshalls HomeGoods, LOFT, and Maurices. Beyond traditional shopping, the center has evolved into a true lifestyle destination with entertainment options including a Regal Cinema Stadium 10 & RPX theater, Sky Zone trampoline park, and Planet Fitness, creating a dynamic atmosphere that extends well beyond retail. Dining options range from casual favorites like Buffalo Wild Wings, Chipotle, and Olive Garden to specialty offerings like Crumbl Cookies and Nothing Bundt Cakes, ensuring visitors can make a full day of their visit. The center also serves the community with essential services including a NYS Department of Motor Vehicles office, Saratoga County Sheriff's Department, and various health and wellness providers, making it a true community hub for the Capital Region.
